correctness.rationale: At the correct unitary Zak normalization b^(-3/2), the 2-sample squared Laurent norm gives exact frame bounds. Enumerated integer translates agree with RESULT.md and an independent 5,508-fiber coefficient/phase check. Reverse triangle and (1+z) factorization show both component minima at z=-1 and give ((U-x)_+)^2+((x-L)_+)^2; the x minimum is x=1/4. Nonnegative Laurent coefficients force the maximum at z=1; endpoint/convexity optimization yields B. The b=7/4 zero and 313/32 factor follow exactly by rational substitution. Finite diagnostics alone do not establish global bounds: the coefficient inequalities and continuous Zak characterization supply the infinite proof.
residual_risks: Finite experiments are supplementary; global claim depends on the specific analytic steps in RESULT.md.
